description.text: Curricula: ·Compulsory courses: Comprehensive Chinese, Chinese Listening, Chinese reading, Chinese writing, Chinese character reading and writing, Chineseconversation, etc. · Elective courses: HSK guidance (elementary & intermediate、advanced), modern Chinese pronunciation, economic and trade newspapers reading, business spoken Chinese, Guzheng (zither), Tai Chi, etc. Tuition fee: · 2 weeks: CNY 1250 · 3 weeks: CNY 1650 · 4 weeks: CNY 2100,adding one week, plus450 per week

duration.text: The Short-term Winter Program at Harbin Engineering University is a 4 Weeks long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 291 USD/In total ￥ 2100 CNY/In total

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.

requirements.text: The healthy foreign citizens above 16 years old.
